simple.meaning: גִּתַּיִם (Gittayim) is a Hebrew word meaning “Gittajim , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גִּתַּיִם (H1664) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Samuel 4:3, with occurrences in 2 Samuel, Nehemiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גִּתַּיִם (H1664) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גִּתַּיִם (H1664) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גִּתַּיִם (Gittayim) / H1664 is traced through 2 Samuel 4:3, Nehemiah 11:33 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
